visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Four individuals—two men and two women—stand against a flat, brightly lit white studio background. The man on the front-left wears a teal and maroon patterned sweater; the woman behind him wears a mixed-pattern blue and brown shirt. To the right, a pink-haired man in a white sweatshirt stands behind a woman in a white frilled top and beige dress. They are gesturing and talking towards the camera. (2) The pink-haired man takes center stage, performing a series of rapid, exaggerated facial contortions. He opens his mouth wide, sticks his tongue out, and bulges his eyes. The camera remains static at a medium close-up shot. Yellow comic-style text bubbles appear briefly around his head. (3) The woman in the blue and brown shirt performs her challenge. She makes a skeptical face, squinting her eyes and twisting her mouth to the side. She then transitions to a shocked expression with an open mouth. The others in the background watch and react with laughter. (4) The man in the teal sweater steps forward. He performs a high-energy sequence, opening his mouth extremely wide as if screaming or shouting. His eyebrows are raised high, and his face tenses with effort. Variety show-style text overlays in yellow and red surround him. (5) The woman in the beige dress performs her sequence, winking one eye and pouting her lips. She then makes a face indicating disgust, with her nose scrunched and mouth pulled down. The camera captures her in a medium close-up, focusing on her micro-expressions. (6) A fifth individual, a man with black hair in a white sweatshirt, appears for his turn. He makes a suspicious, side-eyeing face, shifting his pupils rapidly from left to right while keeping his face mostly still. He then crosses his eyes and sticks out his tongue. (7) The video concludes with the entire group back together in a wide shot, clapping their hands and laughing joyfully. The lighting remains consistent throughout the shoot.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy conversational voices with moderate pitch and high arousal open the track. A light, upbeat, and bouncy electronic BGM plays continuously at 128 BPM. The acoustic environment is a clean studio space. (2) A series of rapid, high-frequency 'bleep' and 'squawk' SFX are triggered, mimicking exaggerated character movements. A female voice produces sharp, non-lexical squawking sounds with high spectral brightness. Explosive group laughter follows. (3) Vocal transitions to a rhythmic sequence of mouth-pops. A series of three distinct 'pop' sounds occur, synchronized with a metallic 'ding' SFX. The BGM remains stable in the background. (4) A rapid-fire vocal sequence of the word 'hamu' is delivered by a male voice with high intensity. This culminates in a sustained, high-pitched scream with visible vocal strain. Laugh track SFX layer under the real group laughter. (5) A sequence of guttural grunts and gagging sounds is performed by a female voice, exhibiting high arousal and comedic tension. The sounds are sharp with short spectral bandwidth. (6) A series of digital UI 'clicks' accompany a male voice producing rapid, shaky electric buzzing sounds. The intensity fluctuates quickly before ending in a loud collective cheer and rhythmic clapping.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is designed to entertain a social media audience through a 'Face-Dubbing Challenge' (表情配音挑戰). The creators take turns performing exaggerated micro-expressions while their companions provide perfectly timed, comedic sound effects, leveraging high-energy performance and fast-paced editing to maximize humor.
